capabilities: render notes as a hierarchical 3D globular cluster graph
mark nodes with study status colors and search priority
preview full Markdown notes in a resizable floating card
sync personal annotations to the end of note files
export the connectome as CSV for VR viewing
disambiguation: Not a neuroscience or anatomy tool; the name refers to visualizing the vault as a brain-like 3D graph.
extras: Distributed via BRAT or manual file installation rather than community plugin review; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Built upon digent-view by Yang Hua and galaxy-view by @longwind1984.
problem: Obsidian's graph view renders notes as a tangled 2D wireframe without hierarchy, status marking, or a way to study and annotate notes in place.

relations.evidence: Built upon digent-view by Yang Hua and galaxy-view by @longwind1984.
